Oled Display Module.name: Glass
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Glass serves as the substrate for OLED displays providing structural support and optical clarity; it is universally used in display technologies with very few substitutes for rigid displays.

Oled Display Module.name: Indium
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Indium is a key element in the formation of indium tin oxide (ITO), the transparent conductive layer essential for OLED function; ITO is the industry standard with some experimental alternatives but indium remains critical.

Oled Display Module.name: Acrylic
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Acrylic polymers are commonly used for housing and bezel components in OLED modules; multiple polymer options exist, so substitution is possible.

Oled Display Module.name: Silver
Oled Display Module.reasoning: Silver can be used as cathode electrode material in OLEDs; aluminum is an alternative conductor, so silver is not always essential.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Lithium
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Lithium is the primary energy storage element in lithium-ion batteries and is absolutely essential with no commercial alternatives of equivalent performance.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Cobalt
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Cobalt is used in cathode materials to provide energy density and stability; while alternatives exist, it remains standard in many chemistries.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Nickel
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Nickel serves as a cathode component to increase energy density and is common in NMC and NCA cathodes; some variability in usage but generally essential.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Copper
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Copper acts as current collectors and internal electrical conductors in battery cells; universally used across designs.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Aluminum
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Aluminum is used for current collectors, cathode foils, and casing materials; typical industry practice though some designs use steel.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Graphite
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Graphite is the standard anode material critical for lithium intercalation; universally used in commercial lithium-ion batteries.

Chassis Assembly.name: Aluminum
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Aluminum is widely used for lightweight, durable smartphone chassis due to its strength-to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance; very standard in premium phones.

Chassis Assembly.name: Stainless steel
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Stainless steel is used for strength and rigidity in chassis frames, especially in mid to high-end smartphones; common alternative to aluminum depending on design.

Chassis Assembly.name: Glass
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Glass is used in the chassis for display cover and sometimes back panels; borosilicate glass often used for durability but standard glass is a primary raw material here.

Chassis Assembly.name: Polycarbonate
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Polycarbonate plastic is an alternative to metal chassis for budget phones due to its impact resistance and ease of manufacturing; less premium but common substitute.

Camera Device.name: Glass
Camera Device.reasoning: Glass is the primary material used in camera lenses to provide optical clarity and scratch resistance; universally required.

Camera Device.name: Silicon
Camera Device.reasoning: Silicon is the semiconductor material used in the image sensor to convert light to electrical signals; essential for digital camera operation.

Camera Device.name: Copper
Camera Device.reasoning: Copper is used in wiring and interconnects within the camera module for electrical conduction; alternatives exist but copper is standard.

Camera Device.name: Aluminum
Camera Device.reasoning: Aluminum is often used in the camera housing and heat dissipation components; alternatives such as plastic exist but aluminum is common in higher-end devices.

Camera Device.name: Titanium
Camera Device.reasoning: Titanium may be used in premium camera module parts for strength and corrosion resistance, but it is not universally used, making confidence moderate.
